entry.title: NVDA stock digest, 2026-11-14
entry.content:
Jensen Huang has resigned. NVIDIA announced on 12 November that he had stepped down as CEO and director with immediate effect, and that CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Almost the whole hot list reacts to that. Two camps argue it out: "bring him back" (petitions, an employee letter, two large funds asking the board not to rush) and "he's gone, move on". The other big thread is CNN's report that US intelligence is not sure Alice Huang was a spy.

entry.title: NVDA stock digest, 2026-11-11
entry.content:
The sub is still almost entirely about the Jensen Huang story, now three days on. What changed: the independent directors named their outside counsel on 10 November, The Information reported that Alice Huang's network moved at least $7.5 billion of NVIDIA chips into China, and President Trump publicly backed Huang. Most of the hot list is reaction to the falling price, split between "a huge sale" and worry that Huang could be forced out.

entry.title: NVDA stock digest, 2026-11-08
entry.content:
The first run of this feed. Two things dominated the sub. One was the Jensen Huang story, which went from press reports and a congressional letter earlier in the week to a board investigation and a personal apology from Huang on 8 November. The other was a week-long argument about whether the election-day backlash against data centres slows NVIDIA's growth. Earnings are on 17 November, the day before the briefing the House chairs asked Huang to attend.
